shared_elements: horned quadruped animals shown in strict profile
animals with patterned, incised fleece/mane treatment
horizontal register of figures moving in one direction
bulls or bovids with curved horns
justification: Both depict horned quadrupeds in strict profile, carved in low relief and arranged as a repeated file of figures moving in the same direction, with stylised patterning used to render fleece, mane and horn coils — a fairly specific shared convention. However, A is a whole architectural panorama with columns, stairways, files of human attendants in robes and lion-attacking-bull groups, while B is a close view of just two rams' heads and shoulders with no human figures or architecture, so the scenes as wholes read very differently.
